changed.pricingAdmin.edit.dailyTasks.title: Guided tasks per day, per tier
changed.pricingAdmin.edit.dailyTasks.desc: How many guided tasks (sessions) a person may start per day: 4 on Lite and Basic, 6 on Advanced, 8 on Premium by default. A plain cap: nothing banks, nothing is earned or traded. Someone must pause or finish the current task before starting another. Resets 11:59 PM ET. Corporate (company) accounts are unlimited unless their admin sets a ceiling.
changed.pricingAdmin.edit.extraHour.desc: Price of one additional hour beyond the monthly included hours. Purchased hours never expire and are drawn only after the plan hours are used up.
changed.pricingAdmin.edit.noDailyTaskCap: Company accounts have no per-day task cap unless their company admin sets one.
changed.pricingAdmin.edit.invalid: Prices must be zero or more, hours per month between 0 and 744, tasks and re-plans whole numbers up to 1000, the carry-forward cap 0 to 100000, and the bulk minimum at least 1.

added.pricingAdmin.edit.monthlyHours.title: Monthly included hours, per tier
added.pricingAdmin.edit.monthlyHours.desc: How many hours of real guiding time each tier includes per calendar month. Every person has one monthly pool that renews on the 1st (US Eastern). A change here reaches every person's live pool at once, as the difference against their current balance, never below zero. Hours beyond the pool come from purchased hours at the per-tier rate below. Fractional hours are allowed (e.g. 37.5).

added.pricingAdmin.edit.monthEnd.capHint: The most that can ever build up in one pool. Leave blank for no cap.
